item.title: Re: A draft featuring the Village People, Shrunken Heads, Neurotoxins and Clickbait
item.content:encoded: I'm speechless. This draft is utterly ridiculous, not-at-all serious, and a complete joke. And the best comedic scip I've read yet. Seriously, how has no one commented on this? The final log is one of the best things about it. You set up a (semi)realistic scenario with the cops, and then turn everything on its head with a cosmic entity. I only have one real question. Why has the Foundation not attempted to use this to help contain/slow down dangerous scips? Although you definitely have enough material, a short addenda talking about perhaps the results of some tests on other scips could provide a comedic sharp contrast between the incident report and a bit of dry, humorless test results. But yes, I certainly found it lovely to read, and you kept me chuckleing the entire time.

Just to let you know what you're in for, it clocks in at 2751 words.

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up extra space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) and titles short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

Howdy. Be prepared for mind-boggling weirdness, as is my brand.

http://scp-sandbox-3.wikidot.com/iamtheooga
You'll know the tab when you see it, it's the one that takes up the entire second row. Any and all feedback is appreciated, but the big thing I'm looking for is if it's enjoyable to read. Did you like it, did you laugh, do you think it's ready to post? It's also my first article in like a year, so I'm certain there's all sorts of little mistakes that need fixing. I know that the final log is a bit weird, so I'd love to know how I should improve it.

Thanks in advance for your time!
